work_packages.title: Canonical Work standard
work_packages.objective: Align canonical Work structure, lifecycle, gates and authority.
acceptance_criteria: README, manifest and architecture define the same top-level and 05_BUILD structures.
Lifecycle, gates and state machine do not contradict one another.

work_packages.title: Work Package registry
work_packages.objective: Define structured WP records, schema and fixed build-area mapping.
acceptance_criteria: Every WP record validates against WORK_PACKAGE.schema.json.
Markdown register matches the JSON source.

work_packages.title: Dashboard reference and data contract
work_packages.objective: Align Dashboard schema, local snapshot and read-only UI.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard renders phases, owners, WPs, blockers, risks, decisions and evidence refs.
Local snapshot is never represented as Core live.

work_packages.title: Core read integration
work_packages.objective: Inspect actual Core endpoints, authorization and freshness before integration.
acceptance_criteria: Actual Core route and implementation are identified.
No live claim without end-to-end evidence.

work_packages.title: Evidence storage and file export
work_packages.objective: Define and later implement controlled persistent storage and JSON/CSV/Markdown exports.
acceptance_criteria: Storage/export architecture is approved against actual Core contract.
Exports are authorized, audited and secret-safe.

work_packages.title: Independent verification and handoff
work_packages.objective: Run independent regression and prepare acceptance evidence.
acceptance_criteria: All required tests executed with reproducible evidence.
Independent QE report and defect disposition exist.
Handoff and release recommendation are traceable.
